generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders.The departments shall not be responsible for non-ccessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connection
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.
Department will not supply any materials, and the cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KP Procurement Portal
The Employer reserves the rights reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Chikodi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates Mentioned.
TheTenderer are should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.
Contractors should Registered in KPWD and copy should be uploaded in Eportal Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
All Item rates are exclusive of GST
The Increase in G.S.T shall not be paid in the extended period of Contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Work Completion/Execution Period is 11.5 months including Monsoon.
The Contractor should maintain the Road in good condition till end tender period
Financial turover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.

The Bidder, at his own cost, responsibility and risk, is encouraged to visit, examine and familiarize himself with the Site of Works and its surroundings including source of earth, water, road aggregates, availability of labor etc. and obtain all information that may be necessary for preparing the Bid and entering into a contract for undertaking the maintenance Works. The costs of visiting the site shall be at the Bidders own expense

The Contractor shall maintain the Road Assets in proper condition that comply with the Road Maintenance Standards and ensure users safety and comfort. The maintenance activities shall be so planned that the defects are repaired well before they reach maximum condition asper the permissible tolerance. After issuing the work order the contractor should complete 25% of the work every month.
If the contractor has not done the maintenance work satisfactorily in previous years such bids will be rejected.
If no bid received auto extension will be done by e-proc itself for 2 days.
The contractor should employe only registered labours as per government circular No. PWD/198/HMS/2009/ Dated: 4/06/2009 as per EPF and MP act 1952. In respect of the employ
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) form practicing Chartered Account is preferred.

Appeal as per the Government Ltr No. 572/CRM/2020/PWD-COMM-1- PWDSEC,Dtated: 09-10-2020 the appeal received in e-proc as per KTTP act/rules within the stipulated time will only the considered. Any written appealreceived shall not be considered.

As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3 If the Tenderer is not ready to make aggrement, Then the EMD amount will be forfeited and tender will be rejected

As per Government Circular No. PWD/48/BMS/2022, Dated 31/05/2024 and KTPP 2000 Rules 26(A) contractor are liable for debarment if contractor does bad quality of work, if contractor fails to complete the work within stupilated period of time and also to follow all other conditions mentioned in the above said Government circular.
Supply of tools and plants (spade, pic axe, pan, sickle)required for maintenance work is to be provided by the Tendrer
Contractor should visit the site and should give certificate that he will maintain the road pot hole free up to the end of tender period.
This tender is reserved for CATEGORY II A Contractors only

In accordance with the notification of Government of Karnataka No. DPAL 22 SHASHANA 2016, Bengaluru dated 29-06-2017 and 17-07-2017 and as per the Finance Secretariat Notification No. FD 876 Exp-12-2017, Bengaluru, dated 15-09-2017, this work is reserved for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe contractors (specified in the Name of work), and only Scheduled caste/Scheduled Tribe/CAT-I/CAT-II(A)contractors shall have to participate in the tender. The Scheduled caste/Scheduled/CAT-I/CAT-II(A) Caste contractors participating in the tender should compulsorily furnish the Caste certificate and Domicile Certificate issued by a competent authority, failing which the tender is liable for rejection
This bid documents clause no 34.4 to be implemented as per deligation of power vide GO No PWD 423 FC-1 2018 Bengalore dated 24.09.2018
Any deviation/error//mistake/found in units of items,they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 and the rates shall be quoted accordingly

The Tenderer shall obtain Any nature of workdone certificate from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 (25% of the Amount Put to Tender i.e., Rs.7.30 Lakhs in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer)and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid

The Tenderer shall achieved in at least One financial years an average annual financial turnover from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 of 29.20 Lakhs (not less than the estimated cost under this contract).

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908
Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Painting two coats with synthetic enamel paint. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Printing  letters  and  figures  of  any  shade  with  synthtic enamel  paint  of  any  approved  colour  to  give  an  even shade. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts - Maintenance  of  Hume  pipe  Culvert  by  way  of    Clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet wall and protection work as per drawing and technical specification Clause 1909. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts Slab type - Maintenance   of   Slab   type   Culverts   by   way   of   clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet walls and Protection works as per drawing and technical specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Retro-Reflectorised Traffic Signs - Providing    and    fixing    of    retro-    reflectorised    cautionary, mandatory  and  informatory  sign  as  per  IRC:67:2022  made of  Class  C  Type  XI  retro  reflective  sheeting  fixed  over   2  mm thick aluminium sheeting vide clause 801.3, 3mm/4mm thick Aluminium composite material sheet depending on the size of the  sign  fixed  over  the  back  support  frame  of  min  25  x  25  x 3mm  angle  mounted  on  a  mild  steel  circular  pipe  65  NB,  3.2 mm thickness firmly fixed to the ground by means of properly designed foundation with M25 grade cement concrete 45 cm x 45 cm x 60 cm, 60 cm below ground level as per approved drawing.The  sign  shall  be  maintained  as  per  section  12  of IRC:67:2022. - 90 cm equilateral triangle

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Kilometre Stone - Reinforced   cement   concrete   M15grade   kilometre   stone   of standard design as per IRC:8-1980, fixing in position including painting and printing etc - Ordinary kilometer stone (precast). Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 805

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Providing  and  Fixing  of  Median  Marker  that  are  made  of tough,  high  impact  resistant,  injection-molded,  thermoplastic body  with  an  isosceles  trapezoidal  structure  of  length,  width and  height  not  less  than  15cm,  10cm  and  10cm  respectively and  thickness  not  less  than  1.8mm,  the  body  structure  shall be  rounded  at  its  acute  angle,  all  the  corners  and  edges.  The plastic  used  for  molding  the  Median  Marker  shall  have  a minimum  Notched  Izod  Impact  strength  value  of  600  J/m  at room  temperature,  when  tested  in  accordance  with  ASTM D256 and shall retain at least 70% of this value when subjected to  accelerated  weathering  for  1000hrs  as  per  ASTM  G155  or UL746C.  The  logo  of  the  manufacturer  shall  be  embossed  on either  side  of  the  body  in  the  injection  molding  process.  The Median   Marker   shall   have   rectangular-shaped,   fluorescent yellow  color  retro-  reflective  sheeting  of  size  not  less  than 8.5cm*8.5cm  and  with  fully  reflective  micro  prismatic  cube corners  as  its  retro-reflective  elements  as  per  IRC  67  2022 and  ASTM  D4956  type  XI  specifications  reflectivity  values. The retro-reflective sheeting shall be one or both sides of the Median Marker and shall  be edge protected with no exposed edges  which  will  prevent  edge  lifting,  vandalism,  sheeting damage, etc. The Median Marker shall be fixed by a combination of epoxy adhesive and grouting as per MoRTH specification 806. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - MoRTH 806

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Road Marking with Hot Applied Thermoplastic Compound with Reflectorising Glass Beads on Bituminous Surface - Providing  and  laying  of  hot  applied  thermoplastic compound 2.5 mm thick including reflectorising glass beads @ 250 g/m2 area, thickness of 2.5 mm is exclusive of surface applied glass beads  as  per  IRC:35:2015.The  finished  surface  to  be  level, uniform and free from streaks and holes. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 803

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with type B Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.
